description: This file defines the interface and API declarations for RBUS core functionality, including connection management, object registration, method invocation, event handling, and internal callbacks. It sets up the data structures, callback types, and constants necessary for interacting with the RBUS messaging bus system.

methods.name: rbus_getOpenTelemetryContext
methods.description: Retrieves the current OpenTelemetry context strings.

methods.name: rbus_setOpenTelemetryContext
methods.description: Sets the OpenTelemetry context with the provided strings.

methods.name: rbus_clearOpenTelemetryContext
methods.description: Clears the current OpenTelemetry context.

methods.name: rbus_openBrokerConnection
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the RBUS broker with a component name.

methods.name: rbus_closeBrokerConnection
methods.description: Closes the current RBUS broker connection.

methods.name: rbus_registerObj
methods.description: Registers an object on the bus with a specified handler.

methods.name: rbus_unregisterObj
methods.description: Unregisters an object from the bus.

methods.name: rbus_addElement
methods.description: Adds an element (attribute) to a registered object.

methods.name: rbus_removeElement
methods.description: Removes an element from a registered object.

methods.name: rbus_registerMethod
methods.description: Registers a method (remote procedure) with an object.

methods.name: rbus_unregisterMethod
methods.description: Unregisters a method from an object.

methods.name: rbus_invokeRemoteMethod
methods.description: Invokes a remote method synchronously and blocks until a response is received or timeout occurs.

methods.name: rbus_publishEvent
methods.description: Publishes an event message to all subscribers for a specific object and event.

methods.name: rbus_registerEvent
methods.description: Registers an event for an object so that clients can subscribe to it.

methods.name: rbus_unregisterEvent
methods.description: Unregisters an event for an object.

methods.name: rbus_subscribeToEvent
methods.description: Subscribes to an event from an object with a callback.

methods.name: rbus_unsubscribeFromEvent
methods.description: Unsubscribes from a specific event of an object.

methods.name: rbus_discoverWildcardDestinations
methods.description: Discovers destinations matching a wildcard expression.

methods.name: rbus_discoverObjectElements
methods.description: Discovers elements of a specified object.

methods.name: rbus_discoverElementsObjects
methods.description: Discovers objects associated with specified elements.

methods.name: rbus_discoverRegisteredComponents
methods.description: Finds all applications currently registered/active with RBUS.

methods.name: rbuscore_checkBusStatus
methods.description: Checks whether RBUS bus is enabled and operational.
